parsed.refutation_attempt: Checked the code for any path that could lead to executing an OS command via the write() system call. The source chunkSize is only used to compute the number of records to read/write and to allocate memory. Even if SIZE were attacker‑controlled, the only effect would be on memory allocation size and the amount of data read/written, not on command execution. No other checks or transformations that could lead to command injection are present. Therefore the reported OS Command Injection claim is unfounded.
